title: Scalar preservation of the specified ordinary Kummer class
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $N\in\mathbf N$ invertible on $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, and $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital map of commutative rings with $NA=NB=0$. Let $e$ be a normalized endpoint record on $P$ [def-sp-p1-kummer-scalar-endpoints]. If $c:A_P\to A_P(1)[2]$ satisfies the fixed $\mathcal O_P(1)$ Kummer specification [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class], then its specified scalar conjugate $e.\operatorname{chernImage}(c)$ satisfies that specification over $B$. No finiteness, Noetherian or coefficient-flatness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Transpose the defining conjugate of c under the scalar adjunction. Naturality, including its shift comparison, gives the Ext equality mk0(unitInsertion) composed with restriction of the transported Ext class equals the original Ext class composed with mk0(lineInsertion). The two derived-normalization fields identify the adjuncts used here.

Forget scalars and precompose with the integral constant generator. The unit normalization sends one to one, so generator followed by forgotten insertion is the target generator. The exact functor that forgets after restriction equals direct forgetting; use exact-functor composition compatibility to compare their Ext maps. It follows that ordinaryFiniteClass of the transported arrow is the cohomology image of the original ordinaryFiniteClass.

The root normalization at coefficient one gives rootMap_A followed by forgotten lineInsertion equals rootMap_B. Apply functoriality of H^2 to the fixed Kummer connecting class of O(1), and substitute the assumed Chern specification. This proves the target specification.

lean.statement:
theorem p1KummerChernScalar
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {φ : A →+* B} {N : ℕ} {hA : (N : A) = 0} {hB : (N : B) = 0}
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (hP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine S, ⊤)))
    (e : P1KummerScalarEndpoints φ N hA hB (ProjectiveLine S))
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S hP c) :
    ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec B N hB S hP (e.chernImage c)
